title: CKAD Practice - Multi-Container Pods (10% of exam)

questions.title: Create a Pod with two containers, both with image...
questions.body: Create a Pod with two containers, both with image busybox and command "echo hello; sleep 3600". Connect to the second container and run 'ls'

questions.title: Create a pod with an nginx container exposed on port 80....
questions.body: Create a pod with an nginx container exposed on port 80. Add a busybox init container which downloads a page using 'echo "Test" > /work-dir/index.html'. Make a volume of type emptyDir and mount it in both containers. For the nginx container, mount it on "/usr/share/nginx/html" and for the initcontainer, mount it on "/work-dir". When done, get the IP of the created pod and create a busybox pod and run "wget -O- IP"

questions.title: Create a Pod with two init containers that run in order
questions.body: Create a Pod named `multi-init` in which a main container `main` (image busybox, command "sh -c 'cat /work/out.txt; sleep 3600'") reads a file assembled by TWO init containers that must run in order. `init-1` (busybox) runs "sh -c 'echo one > /work/out.txt'" and `init-2` (busybox) runs "sh -c 'echo two >> /work/out.txt'". All three share an emptyDir named `work` mounted at `/work`. Verify the init containers ran in order, then read the main container logs.

questions.title: Add a native sidecar that tails the app log
questions.body: Create a Pod named `sidecar-log`. The main container `app` (image busybox) runs "sh -c 'while true; do echo \"$(date) hit\" >> /var/log/app.log; sleep 2; done'". Add a native sidecar container named `logger` (image busybox, command "sh -c 'tail -F /var/log/app.log'") implemented as an initContainer with restartPolicy: Always. Both share an emptyDir named `logs` mounted at `/var/log`. Confirm you can read the streamed lines with 'kubectl logs sidecar-log -c logger'.

questions.title: Ambassador pattern — proxy container in the same Pod
questions.body: Create a Pod named `ambassador-pod` with two containers sharing the network namespace. The main container `app` (image busybox, command "sh -c 'sleep 3600'") is meant to reach an external service through a local proxy. The ambassador container `proxy` (image nginx) listens on containerPort 80. From the `app` container, run 'wget -O- localhost:80' to confirm it reaches the ambassador over localhost.

questions.title: Adapter pattern — sidecar reformats output
questions.body: Create a Pod named `adapter-pod`. The main container `app` (image busybox) runs "sh -c 'while true; do echo raw-metric-$(date +%s) >> /data/metrics.log; sleep 3; done'". The adapter container `adapter` (image busybox) runs "sh -c 'tail -F /data/metrics.log | while read l; do echo formatted:$l; done'". Both share an emptyDir named `data` mounted at `/data`. Read the adapter logs to confirm the reformatted output.

questions.title: Share an in-memory emptyDir between two containers
questions.body: Create a Pod named `mem-cache` with two busybox containers `writer` and `reader`, both running "sh -c 'sleep 3600'". Add an emptyDir named `cache` with medium set to 'Memory' (a tmpfs), mounted at `/cache` in both containers. Exec into `writer`, write a file to `/cache/data`, then exec into `reader` and read it back.

questions.title: Enable a shared process namespace in a Pod
questions.body: Create a Pod named `shared-ns` with `shareProcessNamespace: true` and two busybox containers `c1` and `c2`, both running "sh -c 'sleep 3600'". Because the process namespace is shared, exec into `c1` and run 'ps aux' — you should also see the process of `c2`.
